text:
Macklin Celebrini is 20, the Sharks' captain, and already one of the best players in the league. He has 29 points in 23 games playing 23 minutes a night, and the Sharks, after years at the bottom, are winning: three of their last four.

The numbers say he is doing more than his line suggests. San Jose's share of expected goals is 11 points better with him on the ice than off it. He has 10 goals on 11 expected, shooting a little under his usual rate, so the goals are, if anything, a little behind his chances. He is tied for second in the league in penalties drawn.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile among forwards for setting up shots last season. Every forward picked first to third since 2005 with four-plus seasons reached 200 NHL games, scoring a median 0.55 points a game in their first full year. Celebrini is at 1.26 a game this season. We project him for about 111 points.
headline: Celebrini is outrunning the history of top picks
